summary: Borr Drilling Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial report for Q1 2026 and a copy of an indenture governing $300M 3.50% convertible senior notes due 2033, issued on April 17, 2026. The filing also references forward-looking statements about a new joint venture rig acquisition and a planned Oslo Stock Exchange uplisting. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The notes are a routine financing instrument. What to watch: future developments on the joint venture and exchange listing.
